title: Debit vs credit: which is safer?

lines.text: Debit or credit? They look the same, but they work very differently.
Debit spends money you already have. Credit borrows it, and you pay it back.

left.name: Debit
rows: Stolen cash is gone while it's sorted out

right.name: Credit
rows: Borrows it, you pay it back
Fraud liability capped at $50 by law

lines.text: Paying a credit card on time can build your credit score. Debit doesn't.

lines.text: And fraud? Federal law caps your credit card liability at fifty dollars. With debit, the stolen money leaves your account while it gets sorted out.

lines.text: The catch: carry a balance on credit, and interest gets expensive fast.
